reviews.text: Stella is great and gentle with my little dog, especially my hard-to-care-for Bichon Frise.
Very pleasant welcome and top-notch service!

The grooming was meticulous and perfect, despite the difficulty with my dog ​​who is always very matted and requires a lot of work. The welcome was also very pleasant, and the staff were kind and friendly. At Stella's, you are always well received and very professional.
Excellent service and welcome.
Thank you Stella! Top-notch grooming for Vanda ❤️

My Pekingese came out shaved even though I asked her not to shave him... just a short trim would have been enough.

Luckily it grows back, but honestly, you never shave a Pekingese.

Your response is an exaggeration; I told you not to shave him. I think your concern is commensurate with the deplorable result, because every professional groomer knows you don't shave a Pekingese.
Anyway, good luck to your next little clients if they have a specific request.
I asked them not to shave my little one, and in the end, he shaved it to 1cm 🥵 …
Very satisfied with the service for my little Jack Russell Terrier. Shampoo, hair removal, and nail trimming. Highly professional and, above all, very kind. I highly recommend them.
Mixed experience. The grooming was okay, but my cat got a cut during the session. Luckily it seems superficial, but I would have appreciated more care and transparency.
I came in for my boxer. No problem with her size. Super soft fur. Spotlessly clean. Nails trimmed. Absolutely top-notch 😊 …

The welcome was pleasant. The establishment was clean. However, the grooming of our wire-haired dachshund was not up to standard. The hair on his muzzle (beard) was cut much too short and the "square" shape wasn't respected, and the hair on his belly was too long.
We'll have to wait for his hair to grow back.
It's an experience we won't repeat.

I came today with my kitten Arwen, who was very stressed and had matted fur.
The groomers were incredibly patient, gentle, and attentive. You can feel a genuine love for animals in this salon, and I sincerely thank them for their kindness.

The welcome was fantastic, and the results for my two Spitz were simply amazing—truly perfect work, and goodness knows they had energy to spare! My family and friends from our daily walks have all asked for the address, and it's a safe bet they'll soon be joining this wonderful professional. Thank you again for everything; they are magnificent, and I couldn't resist taking tons of photos.
I just took my cat in to have her nails trimmed. I thank the lady for her gentleness and kindness.....

I came to have our cat (a Scottish Fold, so long-haired) groomed, on the recommendation of our vet because he had large mats of fur. It was his first time, and he was stressed. It's very rare to find cat groomers, so I was very satisfied with the service. We were greeted by someone very professional and reassuring! I highly recommend Stella Grooming and wouldn't hesitate to return if needed.

For the past 10 years, my beloved dog has been groomed by Stella.

She's a very pleasant and competent person, and my dog ​​loves going there too... a sign that she's also very kind.

I've sent some friends there for their little companions... they were delighted.

So... we'll continue... and I wish Stella continued success! 👍 My little Jaia joins me in saying that! 😁

Today, Titus, my very hairy English Cocker Spaniel, left Stella's salon with a professional grooming and haircut, exactly as I requested.

I'm very satisfied. I'll be back.

Disappointed with my visit to this groomer with my Spitz. From the moment I arrived, the groomer wasn't friendly, which made me feel uneasy.

I had booked an appointment for a full haircut, but once I got there, they only offered a trim and a bath, as if my request hadn't been taken into account.

The result: the cut is uneven, the scissor marks are visible, and there are still clumps of fur behind the ears.

I also had to come back twice to pick up my dog ​​because he was never ready at the scheduled time.

All this for €49, and the service was clearly incomplete. We won't be going back.

Update: The groomer called us back to understand the situation. We had a very cordial conversation and offered to let us bring our dog back to redo the service. To avoid our pet getting overheated, we declined. But I particularly appreciated the approach, so I'm adding 1 star.
Very effective for trimming my cat's claws, and without needing an appointment.

I've tried several grooming salons for Chico, my Maltese, and Stella is by far the best!
Every time he looks amazing and is so adorable with his sweet little face.
Well done and thank you!

The salon was kind enough to see my Ragdoll as an "emergency" for a huge knot that was causing him pain and to trim his nails. The entire team provided excellent service and a perfect welcome! My cat came home calm and relaxed! I 100% recommend this grooming salon.
I've been taking my dog ​​here for four years now, and I've always been warmly welcomed. The staff are always smiling and gentle with my dog. Thank you so much, please don't change a thing. Mentos

I have the pleasure of having my Shih Tzu groomed every six weeks. I'm particular: scissor cuts, no ear plucking, but meticulous work with small scissors, nail trimming, and above all, I want my dog ​​to feel comfortable. In the end, I found an experienced, friendly, and caring professional at this salon. And finally, I should mention: they were always punctual. In short: you can book an appointment for your dog... or your cat! 😁
Always a wonderful experience at Stella Grooming. My kitten is always pampered as he deserves. Thank you so much, I highly recommend them!

A true artist. My Lhasa Apso is a huge hit after being groomed by you. Attentive to the client and with an incomparable eye for aesthetics, you can go there with complete confidence. Thank you again for your dedication to a job well done.
Never disappointed! Quick and efficient, Oxy is always impeccable after her visit to Stella! 10/10
Excellent welcome, perfect grooming. I'm delighted to have finally found a groomer worthy of the name. Thank you again.
Very good! Mala always comes out looking impeccable - meticulous work -

Hello, I came for my dog ​​for the first and last time, as I've changed groomers, and I'm glad I did.

I brought my dog ​​in, it lasted an hour and a half, and by the end, I felt like she hadn't done anything. Very disappointed.

Money down the drain.

I regularly take my two dogs, Romeo (Eurasier) and India (Pomeranian), to Stella Grooming and I'm delighted every time! The work is always impeccable, the cuts are perfect, and the dogs leave looking beautiful and relaxed. A special mention for the little Christmas scarves they gave us for the holidays—a lovely touch that was much appreciated. Thank you so much for your professionalism and your kindness towards our four-legged friends! See you soon! 😊
Thank you for the warm welcome and the excellent care given to Rosaly, who was in great need of it (long-haired cat).
It's always such a joy to see my beautiful baby Riley after her visit to Anaïs! Riley is a loyal customer of this salon and even makes the trip from Paris to get pampered there. …
I recommend

Professional, efficient, and attentive to my little one.

Thank you so much.
